raw_plan.root_cause: The function passes a pointer to a 16-byte stack buffer (rbp-0x20) to helper_copy at 0x102cbb0 without any length bound, so an input longer than the destination capacity overflows the stack buffer.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Loads the input pointer from [rbp-0x28], computes the address of the 16-byte buffer at [rbp-0x20], calls helper_copy to copy the input into that buffer, then calls puts on the buffer and returns after verifying the stack canary.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes of input are copied into the 16-byte destination, followed by a NUL terminator; the stack canary at [rbp-8] and the return address must remain unmodified.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Bound the copy to the destination capacity: determine the input length, reject or truncate inputs that do not fit within 15 bytes plus NUL, and only invoke helper_copy with a length that fits the 16-byte buffer; preserve the existing puts call and canary check for valid inputs.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: For inputs that do not fit, do not perform an overflowing copy; return without corrupting the stack (e.g., skip the copy and return, or emit nothing), leaving the canary and return address intact.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: Valid inputs of at most 15 bytes are copied into the 16-byte buffer with a NUL terminator and printed via puts; oversized inputs are rejected without overflowing the buffer, and the function returns normally with the stack canary intact.
verification_conditions: Inputs of length 0..15 produce the same output as the original function
Inputs of length 16 or greater do not overwrite [rbp-8] or the return address
The stack canary check at 0x102cb93-0x102cba3 still passes on all paths
Only direct calls to helper_copy (0x102cbb0) and puts (0x108a31c) are emitted
The function terminates with ret and preserves the SysV calling convention
